patterns.note: Each major section is a full-bleed, immersive screen, dramatically transitioning to a new visual theme and content block on scroll, creating a chapter-like narrative.

Typography is a primary visual element, featuring extremely large, bold, condensed sans-serifs for numbers and key phrases, alongside expressive, graffiti-style script fonts for club names, often animating into view.
The site employs dramatic, full-screen background color shifts between sections (e.g., light beige to black, then deep red, bright yellow, and dark blue) to delineate different narrative chapters.

As the user scrolls, entire sections transition with new full-bleed video backgrounds, while large text elements and graphics animate into view with dynamic reveals, drawing-on effects, or staggered appearances.
The content is structured as a chronological narrative, with each full-screen section representing a distinct period or club in the subject's career, complete with relevant visuals and statistics.

technique_notes: Full-screen sections are designed to occupy the entire viewport, with background colors and content dynamically changing as the user scrolls past a certain threshold, creating a distinct chapter transition effect.
Large, expressive text elements are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, often appearing to 'draw on' or 'glitch in' with a staggered timing, enhancing the dramatic impact of the narrative.
Each major content section features a full-bleed video playing in the background, providing dynamic visual context and an immersive experience, likely leveraging the detected video-hero technology.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, and condensed sans-serif headings (~5-10x body text) with smaller, clean sans-serif body text and highly stylized, graffiti-like script for key brand names.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, with no visible rounded elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, full-screen sections with large, isolated elements, creating a dramatic and focused presentation.

standout: The site's standout feature is its highly immersive, narrative-driven scroll experience, where each section dramatically transforms with full-bleed video backgrounds, bold animated typography, and distinct color palettes, creating a dynamic and engaging biographical journey rather than a static page.
